in_arabic.name: إِبْرَاهِيم
in_arabic.meaning: المرحوم، الحبيب، العزيز، الحكيم، الصادق، المخلص
in_arabic.long_meaning: إِبْرَاهِيم نَبِي الْعَبْرَة وَابن اِسحَق وَابن اِبراهيم، وَهُوَ المُشَيَّر بِالخَلافَة، وَكَذَلِكَ تَقول الْأُمَم، وَلَأَحَقُّ مِن ذَلِكَ الَّذِي جاءَ بِهِ التَّفْسِيرُ، وَالَّذِي يُعْرَفُ بِالوَصِيَّة، وَإِنَّهُ صَلّى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِصَلاَةِ المَنِّ، وَأَمَرَ بِالنَوَازِلِ عَلَيْهِ وَبِالنُجُومِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَخَذَ بِهِ وَدَاعَةَ الرِجَالِ، وَأَمَرَ بِالرِزْقِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَخَذَ بِالرُبَيِّعِ عَلَيْهِ، وَقَضَى عَلَيْهِ بِالذُلُّلِ، وَأَمَرَ بِالنُجُومِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَمَرَ بِالنَوَازِلِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَمَرَ بِالرِزْقِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَخَذَ بِالوَصِيَّةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَخَذَ بِالزُيَافَةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَخَذَ بِالنُجُومِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَمَرَ بِالنَوَازِلِ عَلَيْهِ

Prophet Abraham is considered one of the most important figures in Islamic history and is revered for his unwavering faith and obedience to God. His story and teachings have been passed down through generations, shaping the cultural and religious views in the Islamic world. Ebraheem is also mentioned frequently in the Quran and Hadiths, further emphasizing his importance.
data.spiritual_significance: Ebraheem's name carries a deep spiritual significance. His story teaches us about the importance of faith, submission to God, and obedience to His commands. Abraham's willingness to sacrifice his son Ishmael at God's command demonstrates his unwavering faith and willingness to put God above all else. Ebraheem's faith and trust in God's plan serves as an inspiration for Muslims to trust in Allah's plan and remain steadfast in their faith. Additionally, his name Ebraheem, which means 'father of many', signifies the idea of bringing new believers into the fold and expanding the faith through procreation and spreading knowledge.
